description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended erdafitinib, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating unresectable or metastatic urothelial cancer with susceptible FGFR3 genetic alterations in adults after at least 1 line of treatment for unresectable or metastatic cancer that included a PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor. Erdafitinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
